method: Minimal source-bound prose qualifications authorized by the human; no source re-review, new source blocks, mathematical errata, figures or questions.
reversibility: Every replacement is confined to text/changes/historical_entities, plus the contract-supported English visible title/locale and section boundary anchors. Faithful source_text, source_refs, kind, identity and source.data remain unchanged.

qualifications.topic: Dilute gas spacing and molecular volume
qualifications.retained: Figure $6$, $1$ atmosphere, and the source's tens-of-thousands volume ratio, in order.
qualifications.rationale: Treat spacing as a dilute-gas approximation and the ratio as a source order-of-magnitude example dependent on temperature, species and molecular-volume convention.
qualifications.unresolved: The source does not specify temperature, species or a molecular-volume definition for this ratio; no replacement value or precision is invented.

qualifications.rationale: Scope the explanation to dilute gas, not arbitrary compression or high density.
qualifications.unresolved: No density threshold or real-gas quantitative correction is supplied.

qualifications.retained: Hundreds of meters per second and the collision analogy.
qualifications.rationale: For the same gas in thermal equilibrium, temperature concerns average translational kinetic energy and typical speeds, not one particle's speed; room-temperature speeds vary by gas and individual molecule.
qualifications.unresolved: No new speed, formula, temperature value or distribution is introduced.

qualifications.retained: Weak attraction in the dilute approximation and lack of fixed shape/volume.
qualifications.rationale: Expansion fills available space; source 'unlimited' is not a universal assertion across confinement, external pressure or phase changes.
qualifications.unresolved: No condensation boundary or equation of state is supplied.

qualifications.topic: Liquid cage/hopping model, residence/vibration times and Frenkel
qualifications.retained: Figure $8$, room-temperature water, one trillionth of a second, $10^{-12}\sim10^{-13}$ seconds, temperature trend and source attribution to Yakov I. Frenkel.
qualifications.rationale: Present temporary cages and hopping as a qualitative approximation; retain original estimates without claiming universal fixed periods or establishing historical priority.
qualifications.unresolved: The source gives no precise residence-time definition or derivation and its two time estimates overlap in order of magnitude. No value is corrected, and no universal separation of the timescales is asserted. Frenkel priority remains historical attribution pending independent SCI review.

qualifications.retained: Yakov I. Frenkel, Soviet historical identity, exact $1894\sim1952$ dates, liquid theory, ferromagnetism, atmospheric electricity, Earth's magnetic-field origin and uranium nuclear fission attribution.
qualifications.rationale: Localize the actual source name into natural Chinese and English transliteration; distinguish the textbook's creator/first priority claims from independently established historical conclusions.
qualifications.unresolved: Dates are retained as source identity, not independently reverified. Exclusive priority claims are not established by authoring. Portrait remains unauthorized and pending.

qualifications.retained: Close molecular spacing, Figure $9$, large resisting force and low compressibility.
qualifications.rationale: Explain rapidly increasing short-range repulsion rather than claiming only literal molecular deformation; compressibility is small, not zero.
qualifications.unresolved: The pending illustration may still visually suggest literal molecular deformation; future figure production/review must not imply the rejected exclusive mechanism.

qualifications.retained: Figures $8$ then $10$, rearrangement, gravity/moving-solid pressure examples, and usual container shape.
qualifications.rationale: Equal directional opportunities are scoped to an isotropic quiescent liquid without directional driving; net flow uses an unbalanced drive in the approximate cage/hopping picture.
qualifications.unresolved: No constitutive law, anisotropic-fluid claim or promise of flow under a balanced force is made.

qualifications.retained: Thermally driven hopping, long duration compared with residence time, and short-time elastic-like response.
qualifications.rationale: Scope unchanged total hopping rate to weak drive; duration alone is not sufficient for flow, and elastic-like behavior depends on relevant relaxation time, material and observation timescale.
qualifications.unresolved: Residence and structural relaxation times are not equated quantitatively. No universal liquid response or relaxation constant is invented.

qualifications.retained: Vibration near equilibrium, occasional relocation, and stable shape/volume.
qualifications.rationale: Use usual observation times and small forces; neighbor connections are persistent, not absolutely unbreakable.
qualifications.unresolved: No diffusion, creep, melting threshold or rearrangement rate is quantified.

qualifications.retained: Source crowd/order analogy, lattice, salt/diamond/magnesium, and Figures $11$, $12$, $13$, $14$ in order.
qualifications.rationale: Restrict long-range periodic order to crystals, distinguish amorphous solids, identify salt particles as ions, and scope regular outer shape to suitable growth. Modern Chinese 金刚石 is a spelling modernization only; source 金钢石 remains unchanged.
qualifications.unresolved: No lattice geometry or mineral identity is inferred from unopened figures. All four referenced diagrams remain pending.

qualifications.retained: Pressure, temperature, molecular properties, number and speed, many-particle complexity and subsequent gas-only treatment.
qualifications.rationale: Avoid the unsupported universal claim that quantitative theory cannot be simple; distinguish the qualitative picture from treatment of many-particle statistical behavior.
qualifications.unresolved: No new theory or equation is added.
